# Experimental Bluetooth 5.1 AoA and RSS Indoor Localization Dataset

Bluetooth 5.1 measurements from nine indoor anchors and two tags with synchronized RSS, AoA azimuth/elevation and accurate ground truth across calibration, static, and mobility scenarios.
